scope: Native signer, durable gate, local evidence exchange and native validation; no public deployment or production-readiness claim.
source_state: Final hardening changes on the recorded base. Source and binary hashes identify observed inputs, not reproducible-build proof.

python.command: SHAREPOOL_SIGNER_BINARY=<built signer> python3 -B -m unittest discover -s contrib/sharepool -p 'test_*.py'

covers: Distinct full origin templates and native owner signatures exchanged through loopback HTTP
Native full-body validation before share admission and local known-work omission rejection
Exact direct coinbase payouts to two owners and native P2P block relay
Late old-template work retained across service restart
Fresh gate receives eligible historical full origins after native tip advances
Deliberate withholding preserves partial durable progress; exact retry completes admission
Previous winner and late proof settle once, with the current winner left for a later job
160 additional native blocks cross the former 128-receipt lifetime limit
Exact subsidy payouts across the regtest height150 halving
Retention pruning and gate restart preserve exact active inventory
Administrative rollback below retained anchor latches local recovery without peer penalty
Restoring native chain and reopening gate does not silently clear recovery
native_peer_integration.deep_rollback_scope: Administrative invalidateblock test. Actual P2P competing-branch tests are recorded separately in native-adversarial.json.

gate.pruning: Only origin_height <= saved_native_anchor_height - 3; paid/orphaned evidence retained until cutoff
gate.revision: Permanent signed64 high-water; pruning never reuses sequence
gate.recovery: Persistently refuses admission when the saved native anchor disappears; no clear-latch API
gate.parser_fix: Canonical byte-bounded structural preflight and exact-read stream precede the framework deserializer

limitations: Loopback-only transport library; no WAN discovery, TLS or deployment daemon
Trusted local factory/RPC timeout contract; arbitrary local factory or CPU work is not hard-preempted
Permissionless evidence validation does not prove complete disclosure or use of a particular DATUM executable
Fixed easy regtest share target and 32-share snapshots; no measured TH/s cap or large-pool economic/scaling claim
Historical full-body validation needs recent native block and undo data
Deep-history archive recovery remains an explicit operational gap
Native owner keys are protected unencrypted local files; production key provisioning/recovery remains open
Sanitizer work is a bounded deterministic corpus run, not sustained coverage-guided fuzzing
Not an external independent security review; additional platforms and activation design remain open
